page.overview:
What is Finizen?

Finizen is a small cetacean Pokémon that resembles a dolphin. Its body is primarily aquamarine with a white underbelly. Finizen has a pair to pink eyes and a cream-colored dorsal fin.

Finizen is a very playful Pokémon and will usually interact with its own species. In Paldea, Finizen often view Barraskewda as a potential rival as both species are competing for food. Dragalge is Finizen's natural predator.

Finizen emits ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other Pokémon. The water ring attached to Finizen's tail is made from a mixture of sticky fluids (which Finizen secretes from its blowhole) and seawater.

Finizen evolves into Palafin starting at level 38 when in a Union Circle with another player.
